scope: Starting defaults for new video projects; project brief/design overrides. Existing approved projects are not retrofitted. Carousel and presentation dimensions must be set separately.

captions.status: Current showcase default; confirm fit and timing on actual footage
captions.progression: cumulative word-onset gray-to-ivory; spoken words stay ivory until phrase clears

safe_area.status: conservative starting margins; verify in current platform preview

he.note: ivrit.ai Hebrew fine-tune of Whisper large-v3-turbo, ggml f16. SHA-256 read from the Hugging Face repo's file-tree API (LFS oid) on 2026-11-08 and independently confirmed by downloading the file and running sha256sum on it the same day; Task 18 should still verify this hash after its own download.

en.note: Official whisper.cpp base.en model (ggerganov/whisper.cpp on Hugging Face). SHA-256 read the same way as the Hebrew model's, and independently confirmed by downloading the file and running sha256sum on it on 2026-11-08.

sound_design.creative_priority: polish, suspense, energy, and payoff through purposeful music, effects, and silence
sound_design.preferred_library: None required: generate effects locally or use suitable free assets; a personal library is optional
sound_design.subscription_status: No subscription needed. If you use your own sound library, confirm your access and usage rights for each project.
sound_design.sfx_preference: Sparse physical mouse clicks, clean snaps or pops; avoid squishy, rubbery, pitched and downward digital accents

editing.default: performance-led; preserve natural breaths and gestures
